figurative_meaning_bn: পিণ্ডদানকালের কলা খাওয়া অর্থাৎ মারা যাওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: To die (used as a special insult referring to eating bananas during funeral rites)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুই কলা খাওয়া, এতটা বাজে কথা বলিস না!
ওরা কলা খাওয়া হোক, এমন অপমান করল!
example_sentences_in_english: You eat a banana, don't talk such nonsense!
May they eat a banana, they insulted me so badly!
history: This idiom draws from the Hindu shraddha ritual of pinda daan, where bananas are offered as food to the deceased's soul during post-death ceremonies, implying a curse of death.
note: Primarily used in rural or traditional Bengali contexts as a harsh insult wishing death upon someone.
